data.description: US funding-stress warning with construction-PIT evidence limits and explicit eligibility flags.

environmentVariables.name: SEICHE_MCP_PUBLIC
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the eight free public tools shipped by seiche 0.9.1 over stdio: funding_stress_now, historical_analogs, proof_backtest, data_health, crypto_stress_record, institutional_flows, oil_funding_context, fx_materials_passage. The hosted 0.10.0 endpoint adds latest_article for nine anonymous tools.

entries.description: Nine anonymous tools for the latest full-text editorial, current US dollar funding regime, historical analogs, data health, institutional positioning, crypto transmission, oil/FX/material context, and a historical diagnostic with misses and eligibility flags.
representativeQueries: What is the current US dollar funding stress regime?
What historical episodes most resemble today?
How accurate has this funding stress model been?
How are hedge funds positioned in the Treasury basis trade?
Are oil, FX or material cash demands—including current Cushing stocks and Brent−WTI basis—reaching dollar funding markets, and which structure figures are dated references?

entries.description: Curated OpenAPI contract for current funding conditions, Ballast and oil-market structure, FX/material context, series provenance, public methodology, and health endpoints.
representativeQueries: Give me an API for the current dollar funding regime.
Retrieve repo, reserves and Treasury cash conditions with provenance.
Check whether the Seiche data feeds are fresh.
Retrieve compact oil-funding, live-vs-reference market structure and FX-material transmission context.
